title: security: rbac v2 enforce KMS region pinning + audit logging hardening
author: Sofia Chen
description: This PR implements RBAC v2 enforcement for KMS key region pinning along with audit logging hardening to meet upcoming compliance requirements and to close a recent support escalation (SUP-1345). Motivation: customers must be able to enforce that secrets and customer-managed KMS keys are only usable in allowed regions; audit trails must include explicit KMS key residency metadata so security teams can validate data residency. Summary of changes: 1) policy enforcement: add region_pin constraint in the RBAC v2 policy evaluator and reject resource binds that violate residency rules; 2) KMS integration: wire a KMS residency check into the crypto service and surface key_region in the key metadata API; 3) audit logging: extend audit events to include kms_key_id and kms_key_region fields, add structured JSON fields for residency decisions and policy id; 4) migration tooling: helper script to flag existing policies missing region_pin and to provide automated suggestions; 5) configuration: Helm and Terraform toggles for enforcement mode (audit-only vs enforce) to allow gradual rollout; 6) docs and tests: end-to-end integration tests plus docs covering the migration and operational playbook. Backwards compatibility: default behavior is audit-only unless the cluster admin flips enforcement=true in the RBAC config; the policy schema version is bumped to v2.3 and the server will log a deprecation warning if older policies are used without an explicit migration. Testing and CI: unit and integration coverage added for policy evaluator, kms residency checks, and audit payload schema; manual QA performed in staging with a small canary cohort. Rollout plan: enable audit-only in staging for 48 hours, enable enforcement in non-prod for one week, then progressively enable enforcement for Trusted tenants, followed by org-wide enforcement with a migration runbook. Revert plan: enforcement can be toggled off via the Helm value and the migration script can be used to roll back policy changes. Checklist: [x] policy evaluator implemented, [x] kms residency hooks added, [x] audit schema extended, [x] migration tooling, [x] docs updated, [x] integration tests. References: Linear ENG-9123, Security ticket SEC-228, Support SUP-1345. See docs/security/kms-region-pinning.md for operator guidance.

release_notes: Add RBAC v2 region_pin enforcement and KMS residency audit fields. Default mode is audit-only; operators can enable enforcement via Helm/Terraform flags. Includes migration tooling and docs. Recommended rollout: enable audit-only, review dry-run reports, then enable enforcement per the runbook.
notes_for_ops: Operators: before enabling enforcement, run scripts/migrate_policies_v1_to_v2.py --dry-run and review the generated report. Enforcement is toggled via values.rbac.enforcement.enabled (false by default). KMS residency checks require updating KMS key metadata; see docs/security/kms-region-pinning.md.
